pr_title: drivers: wifi: esp: Retry command for getting IP settings
pr_body:
If AT_CIPSTA? command fails it is retried again after 5 seconds.

Fixes #25741

Signed-off-by: Tobias Svehagen <tobias.svehagen@gmail.com>
pr_comments:
@pfalcon Those failures are all qemu_arc related. qemu_arc has been disabled since in CI tests in master (7d10b68baaaa8fcf32610f1c65156685dc87cc6d).

@tsvehagen One more rebase will most probably solve build issues and make CI green :)

review_comments: This 5 second hardcoded value seems quite arbitrary. Should we provide a Kconfig option for that so that the value can be tweaked if needed?

Thought so as well. But first question is: what are the chances we will get into this code path? If that is pretty low (e.g. if we haven't noticed that so far), then I would leave it *without* Kconfig option for simplicity of the end user. We can always add such option in future if we notice that AT+CIPSTA? fails frequently (or that we can notice that from time to time during debugging).
Would be nice to have some `LOG_WRN()` or `LOG_ERR()` here.
Main reason to have this log is to find out how frequently does AT+CIPSTA? fail. Then we can better tweek or export 5s timeout as Kconfig, as @jukkar proposed.
